newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FPB Bank unit sets multi-tranche FRCD.
newsitem.headline: FPB Bank unit sets multi-tranche FRCD.

text.p: First Pacific Bank, a unit of FPB Bank Holding Co Ltd, has launched the following floating rate certificate of deposit issue, arranger Westdeutsche Landesbank said.

TRANCHE (B) IN U.S. DOLLARS
